name: Baizhi

tierList.prydwen: T3 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes (Support)

kit.intro: 4-star (free) Glacio Rectifier healer/support. Attacks via her companion You'tan. Forte gauge (4 stacks max, gained per Basic Attack) spent via Skill or Heavy Attack for team healing + Concerto generation. Outro grants 15% all-type DMG Deepen + healing over time to next character; Inherent Skill 1 drops a pickup-able 'Euphonia' (+15% ATK to whoever grabs it).

skills.normalAttack: Destined Promise - up to 4 hits via You'tan, Glacio DMG.
skills.resonanceSkill: Emergency Plan - Glacio DMG + team heal, generates Concerto based on Forte stacks consumed.
skills.forte: Cycle of Life / Concentration - up to 4 stacks, consumed by Heavy Attack or Skill for continuous team HoT + extra Concerto/Resonance Energy.
skills.liberation: Momentary Union - team heal + 4 (6 at S4) auto-firing Remnant Entities (Glacio DMG + healing, counts as Coordinated Attack).
skills.intro: Overflowing Frost - Glacio DMG plunge + team heal.
skills.outro: Rejuvinating Flow - HoT (1.54% Max HP/3s for 30s) to next character, who also gains 15% all-type DMG Deepen for 6s.

echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (5pc, +15% team ATK on heal)
Moonlit Clouds (alt, ER + Outro ATK buff)

teams.name: Generalist Support
teams.notes: Very flexible free 4-star healer; incompatible with Coordinated-Attack hybrids (Yinlin, Zhezhi, Mortefi) since her buffs target only one character at a time.

rotation: S0R0: Intro -> Basic P1-4 -> Skill (swap, DPS collects Euphonia) -> Ultimate -> Basic P1-3 -> Echo -> Outro (~6.5s). Concerto weapon (Variation) shortens the field-time rotation to ~4.3s.
communityNotes: Prydwen: solid free generalist support/healer with a strong Outro (persistent DMG Deepen) and S5 team-revive utility, but outclassed by the 5-star generalists Verina (faster rotation) and The Shorekeeper (stronger buffs); Euphonia pickup mechanic can be awkward to route to the right DPS. Good budget/F2P pick, not meta-defining.
